title: Carousel Video Ads for Product Stories | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a short video of that one item, shot by shot. Add your headline and price after download. Pick a shape for the post or product page.
h1: Carousel Video Ad That Walks Through One Product
lead: A water bottle can get the whole clip: closed, opened on a table, then the lid in frame at the end. Bring one photo of that bottle. You do not have to hire a model for this file.
steps_h2: How to Make a Carousel Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You leave with one clip of the lunch bag, in the shot order you write.

steps.d: Use one product-page photo of the lunch bag, keeping the full bag visible. The file stays focused on that product.
List the shots of this lunch bag: closed, open, strap. Add a short script and pick 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
Set the voice in the editor and save a file with nothing stamped on it. Add your headline and price after download.

faq.q: What is a carousel video ad?
faq.a: One video that stays on a single product the whole way: closed, in use, then a last clear view. It is a video, not a row of still cards.

faq.q: How does a carousel video ad get built?
faq.a: Upload the backpack photo and write the shot order yourself: zipped, open, strap. You can change the words and pick 9:16 or another shape, then download.

faq.q: Which clothing categories fit, and what else can it show?
faq.a: If you have a photo of the garment, it can be the one product in the clip, whether it is a work jacket or a running short. A brush, a pan, or a planter can take the same treatment. Each file stays on one product.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. The scarf photo stays. Write a second opening for shoppers who bought the navy one last year. Another language can be its own file.

faq.q: Who is a carousel video ad for?
faq.a: A shop that wants one clip to stay on a single product, on the product page or in a paid placement. Clothing labels use the same path for a single garment.
Yes. Bring the candle photo. Fix the line about the scent in the editor on this site, set the voice, and download.

faq.q: How soon can I have a file to post?
faq.a: Once the frying pan photo is uploaded, the next screen is the editor, not a hold for a studio. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Where can I post the file?
faq.a: On TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and your product page. Shapes are a tall phone video at 9:16, a square at 1:1, a wide screen at 16:9, plus 4:3 and 3:4. The download has nothing stamped on it.

A clip spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see the number before it starts. If the clip fails, those credits come back. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Do I pay to make a carousel video ad?
faq.a: Yes. Making the clip spends credits.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or my own software?
faq.a: Yes. A product page can steer the first draft. Your shop software can send the photo through the API. Put the headline and the price on after download.

faq.q: Can the voice be in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Make the same clip with a voice in another language, then post that version.
